QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Transformed King
QuestInfo.0: This kingdom, once small yet filled with happiness, has suffered a drastic transformation. #p2161002# says the king, who has been corrupted by the Black Mage, must be stopped. Hear what #p2161002# has to say.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2161002# says the current king has changed so much that he isn't the same king he once served. He asks that you stop the king, and claims that this is the last act of loyalty he will permit himself.



According to #p2161002#, the Lion King can be found in the Audience Room, located in between the Fourth and Fifth Towers. Before you can enter the Audience Room, however, you must eliminate the nearby #o8210004#. Defeat the #o8210004#.

QuestInfo.2: You have weakened the forces of the Black Mage by eliminating the #o8210004#. Perhaps you can enter the Audience Room now?

0.0: I lost my life long ago, but I still maintain my loyalty to this kingdom. We can't bring back the past, but we can't just sit and watch evil take this place. Please, I beg you... Please #bdefeat my king#k.
0.1: My purpose in life was to guard the king, but he is no longer my king. The Black Mage changed him so much that I no longer recognize him. I'd rather defeat him with my own hands than leave him like this. That is the last act of loyalty I can perform... But I need your help.
